title: Specify bandwidth and hopset constraints
description:
Specify source-backed bandwidth, spacing and eligible-hopset constraints as inputs for admission.01 and production ledger work. Distinguish nominal bandwidth from measured 20 dB or 6 dB bandwidth, physical frequencies from indices, and ordinary FHSS branches from DTS and hybrid conditions.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Deliver a declarative constraint and example-case handoff, not a second admission implementation or production-derived oracle. admission.01 should consume this output through a coordinator-wired dependency; this producer must not depend on its consumer. No RF or regulatory classification is authorized.
acceptance_criteria: Independent tables cover the below-250-kHz FHSS 49/50-channel boundary, the separate at-least-250-kHz branch, spacing, duplicate frequencies, band edges and masks reducing eligibility. Each expected result has a rule citation and declared operating-basis assumption. Unknown measured bandwidth cannot become a pass.
